Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?
 

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.
 

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.
 

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.
 

What your day-to-day will look like:
 

 
• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
 
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
 
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
 
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
 
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
 
• Supporting transitions between production zones
 
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time 

 
• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
 
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
 
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
 
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
 
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
 
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
 
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
 
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

jobs.occupation: Hays - Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and performance of IT services delivered by external suppliers. Working in an international multi-vendor environment, you will monitor service delivery, challenge vendors and drive structural improvements across IT services.
Your main responsibilities include

• Leading regular supplier service reviews and contributing to quarterly business reviews.

• Monitoring SLAs, service performance, breaches and supplier actions.

• Challenging vendors on performance, root-cause analyses and recurring service issues.

• Identifying opportunities for structural and continuous service improvement.

• Coordinating issues involving multiple IT suppliers and driving them towards resolution.

• Maintaining the SLA framework, service catalogue, vendor register and renewal calendar.

• Validating supplier invoices, cloud consumption and software licensing against contractual scope.

• Supporting contract renewals and amendments.

• Coordinating service transitions when IT services move between suppliers.

• Contributing to service reporting and overall supplier governance.

What you'll get in return

In return for your expertise, you will receive an attractive salary package including

• Gross monthly salary between EUR5,000 and EUR6,100.

• Company car

• Group and hospitalization insurance

• EUR125 NET/month allowance

• Meal vouchers of EUR8 per worked day and EUR250 eco vouchers per reference year

• Bonus potential of 10% of the annual gross salary, subject to the applicable bonus plan

• Laptop and mobile phone/subscription

• 26 holidays

• A 39-hour working week with flexible working hours and time registration

• After the first three months of office-based onboarding, two teleworking days per week, with fixed days agreed with the supervisor. Teleworking from abroad is not possible.

You combine solid experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery and Vendor Management with a good technical understanding of infrastructure and cloud environments.

• You have at least 10 years of relevant IT experience, ideally within outsourced or multi-vendor environments.

• You have experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery, Service Integration, Vendor Management and/or Supplier Governance.

• You have a strong understanding of infrastructure, cloud and security, allowing you to challenge external IT suppliers.

• Experience working with offshore, nearshore and multi-vendor environments is an advantage.

• You are comfortable leading service review meetings involving multiple external suppliers.

• You communicate clearly and diplomatically with technical, business and external stakeholders.

• You are structured, proactive, solution-oriented and able to challenge vendors constructively.

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage.

• You have a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please contact Alexia Brosens from Hays or click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.
